display_fil:
Lumapit si Aling Nena tungkol sa pangangailangan ng anak niya.
Katuwang si Marites ng midwife sa primary care team.
Hindi niya kailangang sagutin o gamutin ang lahat.
display_en:
Aling Nena asks for help for her child.
Marites works with the midwife in the primary care team.
She need not answer or treat everything.

display_fil:
Tinanong ni Marites kung anong tulong ang kailangan.
Pinakinggan niya ang sagot at nilinaw ang naunawaan.
Hindi siya nanghula ng sakit o paggamot.
display_en:
Marites asks what help is needed.
She listens and checks what she understood.
She does not guess at illness or treatment.

display_fil:
Mga halimbawa: pakikipanayam, vital signs, pagtatala, household profile, paunang lunas.
Gawin lamang ayon sa pagsasanay, lokal na patakaran, at pangangasiwa.
Kapag lampas sa saklaw, humingi ng gabay.
display_en:
Examples: interviewing, vital signs, recording, household profiles, first aid.
Act only within training, local policy, and supervision.
When beyond scope, seek guidance.

display_fil:
Kumpirmahin ang angkop na health worker o pasilidad.
Sabihin kung sino ang kakausapin at paano makakarating.
Tiyaking naunawaan ni Aling Nena.
display_en:
Confirm the appropriate health worker or facility.
Explain whom to contact and how to reach them.
Check that Aling Nena understands.

display_fil:
Kumpirmahin ang tagubilin ng health team.
Alamin kung ano ang itatala at kailan magfo-follow-up.
Ipaabot ang update sa tamang tao.
display_en:
Confirm the health team’s instruction.
Know what to record and when to follow up.
Update the right person.

display_fil: Makinig, manatili sa saklaw, gumabay, at mag-follow-up.
display_en: Listen, stay within scope, guide, and follow through.

check.prompt_fil: Tinanong ni Aling Nena si Marites kung anong gamot ang ibibigay sa anak niya. Hindi saklaw ng pagsasanay ni Marites ang pagbibigay ng payong iyon. Ano ang pinakamainam niyang gawin?
check.prompt_en: Aling Nena asks Marites what medicine to give her child. Giving that advice is outside Marites's training. What is her best response?

options.fil: Magmungkahi ng gamot batay sa karaniwang ginagawa ng kapitbahay.
options.en: Suggest a medicine based on what neighbors usually do.

options.fil: Sabihing pumunta sa health center at tapusin na ang usapan.
options.en: Tell her to go to the health center and end the conversation.

options.fil: Makinig, humingi ng gabay sa health team, ipaliwanag ang susunod na hakbang, at kumpirmahin ang follow-up.
options.en: Listen, seek health-team guidance, explain the next step, and confirm the follow-up.

check.feedback_fil: Hindi nagbibigay si Marites ng payong lampas sa kanyang pagsasanay. Tinutulungan niya si Aling Nena na makausap ang angkop na health worker at sinusunod ang tagubilin ng team sa follow-up.
check.feedback_en: Marites does not give advice beyond her training. She helps Aling Nena reach the appropriate health worker and follows the team’s follow-up instructions.
